data.name: Maafirat
data.gender_notes: Maafirat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arabic: عفورات (Ma'foo-rat) - derived from the root 'afw' meaning to pardon, forgive, or show mercy. In Islamic tradition, Maafirat is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing the forgiveness and mercy of Allah SWT. The name Maafirat carries the meaning “Forgiveness, Mercy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maafirat usually hope their child will grow to embody forgiveness, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek forgiveness and strive for redemption
data.etymology: Maafirat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forgiveness, Mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maafirat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
